from build123d import *

outer_diameter = 38.4
inner_diameter = 30.0
length = 80.0
shoulder_length = 20.0
shoulder_diameter = 45.3
chamfer_size = 2.0

outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
inner_radius = inner_diameter / 2.0
shoulder_radius = shoulder_diameter / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (0, outer_radius))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (length - shoulder_length, outer_radius))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (length - shoulder_length, shoulder_radius))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (length, shoulder_radius))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (length, 0))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.X)

solid_body = p.part
solid_body = solid_body - Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(inner_radius, length)

top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.X)[-1]
solid_body = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

part = solid_body
part.name = "stepped_shaft"
export_step(part, "output.step")

arm_length = 80.0
arm_width = 10.0
arm_thickness = 5.6
hole_diameter = 3.0
hole_spacing = 12.0
hole_offset = 15.0
fillet_radius = 0.2

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (arm_width, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (arm_width, arm_length))

            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=arm_thickness)

        x = fc.X + hole_offset + i * hole_spacing
        y = fc.Y + j * hole_spacing
        solid_body = solid_body - Pos(x, y, fc.Z) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, arm_thickness * 2)

part = solid_body
part.name = "arm_with_holes"
export_step(part, "output.step")
